notes.title: Trend Alert — AI Infrastructure Capex Cycle
notes.excerpt: Hyperscaler capex commitments for 2026 now exceed $280bn. We see durable demand for semiconductor equipment, power infrastructure, and cooling solutions through 2028.

notes.title: The Week Ahead — 7 July 2026
notes.excerpt: US payrolls surprised to the upside. European PMIs stabilising. Focus this week: ECB minutes (Wed), US CPI (Thu), earnings pre-season begins.

notes.title: Focus Stock: ASML — Secular Winner in Litho
notes.excerpt: ASML's High-NA EUV monopoly positions it as the critical enabler of sub-2nm chips. Order book visibility through 2028 supports our HC conviction.

notes.title: European Defence — Structural Rearmament
notes.excerpt: NATO spending commitments now averaging 2.8% of GDP across European members. Rheinmetall, BAE Systems, and Thales remain our top picks.

notes.title: Canadian Natural Resources — Downgrade to Hold
notes.excerpt: Oil price normalisation below $70 pressures FCF generation. Valuation now fair at 6.2x EV/EBITDA. We move to Hold from Buy.
